description:
"It's a preference, I'll change it, I'll change baseball!  
I'll cater to your every whim, even your bedtime routine."  
A man suddenly appeared in front of Seung-ha, Chai-en, and a contract marriage was arranged!  
But the man was cold, and the end was a prearranged divorce.  
'I admit it! I was once attracted to him, but now... I want to destroy that attraction!  
"Divorce. We're not compatible on every level!"  
When I declared my intention to divorce him, he went straight for it!
